description: This file defines the BillingClient class within the AWS SDK for PHP, used to interact with the AWS Billing service. It includes PHPDoc annotations specifying available methods for billing operations, both synchronous and asynchronous.

classes.name: BillingClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the AWS Billing service, extending the core AwsClient class and providing billing-specific methods.

methods.name: createBillingView
methods.description: Creates a new billing view in AWS.

methods.name: createBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new billing view.

methods.name: deleteBillingView
methods.description: Deletes an existing billing view.

methods.name: deleteBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a billing view.

methods.name: getBillingView
methods.description: Retrieves details of a billing view.

methods.name: getBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves billing view details.

methods.name: getResourcePolicy
methods.description: Fetches the resource policy associated with billing.

methods.name: getResourcePolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the resource policy.

methods.name: listBillingViews
methods.description: Lists all billing views.

methods.name: listBillingViewsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all billing views.

methods.name: listSourceViewsForBillingView
methods.description: Lists source views associated with a billing view.

methods.name: listSourceViewsForBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists source views for a billing view.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource in AWS billing.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously tags a resource.

methods.name: untagResource
methods.description: Removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.

methods.name: updateBillingView
methods.description: Updates an existing billing view.

methods.name: updateBillingViewAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates a billing view.
